chapter: Dancing schools, Sapiro and Jelly Roll Morton
title: Morton's Red Hot Peppers on tour and recording in New York
summary: The band played dance halls in Pennsylvania coal country; Procope confirms the group was billed as Jelly Roll Morton and his Red Hot Peppers and recorded in New York.

bands.name: Jelly Roll Morton and His Red Hot Peppers

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Well, what sort of places did you play at?
Dance halls. Dance halls. Every town had a dance hall and every town had a band.
And it was called Jelly Roll Morton's orchestra?
Jelly Roll Morton and his Red Hot Peppers.
Oh, it was the Red Hot Peppers.
And was it during that period that you recorded with him?
No, we recorded in New York.
